tbesh_html:
1) (Hiphil) to smell, scent, perceive odour, accept
1a) of horse
1b) of delight (metaph)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to blow, i.e. breathe; only (literally) to smell or (by implication, perceive (figuratively, to anticipate, enjoy)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: accept, smell, [idiom] touch, make of quick understanding.
